en: Black‑and‑white photograph showing four men in straw boater hats rowing a wooden boat on a calm pond or small lake. Behind the water is a line of leafy trees, beyond which stand historic masonry buildings, including a prominent church with a tall, slender tower topped by a bulbous spire and cross. Another large, simple gabled building with small windows stands to the right. The scene has a tranquil, park-like atmosphere. No printed caption or text is visible on the image.
